notes.title: v1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello playtesters!

Time for another QoL update we need your help testing!

[b]What's Changed[/b]
[list]
[*] Extraction pipes should now suck you in properly like Super Mario! No more dying when you should have won!
[*] Scorch biome spawners should now feel less sucky and show what you need to do to destroy them   
[*] Special shoutout to KuroMcWuff who was missing from the credits! Are you also a playtester who isn't listed but wants to be? Tell me! I'm dumb like that!
[*] We will now show you what you need to evolve passengers when picking them on pizza delivery.
[*] Enemies now climb obstacles! No more ramp camping!
[*] Are you often falling into oblivion? You should now be comfortably teleported back into reality!
[*] Your last vehicle and skin used will now be remembered
[*] The forest will look prettier
[*] Cliffs in the tornado map and the first scorch map should now feel cooler!
[/list]

A special request for those of you on weaker machines! Please tell us if this update is significantly laggier for you!
Especially the Steam Deck users!

Let's us know what you think!

Kikimora Crew

notes.title: v0.1.7
notes.content:
Hello playtesters!

We just released v0.1.7 which includes 2 new weapons and a new map for you to try out and tell us what you think!

First thing you will notice is that you now start the game with [b]everything[/b] unlocked. 
This included unfinished levels, upgrades and vehicles. 
Seems like the easiest way for y'all to get access to stuff without having to grind it out.

We added 2 new weapons to this build, try them out, and tell us what you think!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050579/703a8c826fa27a632f822a8e020b96dc60c93236.png[/img]

[h2]Beake[/h2]
Spawns drones that fly around your vehicle, dropping bombs on enemies. Should be a useful AOE attacker.

[h2]Nice Queen[/h2]
Shoot 1 big icicle in front of the vehicle, and a bunch of small missile the higher your attack count it. Can FREEZE enemies, which is a completely new feature ( status effects!)

The new tornado map is also ready to try out!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050579/b8c56f718b3f2334bcb94fc448505da01546556e.png[/img]

It features 2 extraction points, so no more spawn camping, and a bunch of tornadoes that will throw you around!

Give it a spin and tell us what you think!

Thank you for supporting our indie dream ❤

We can't wait to hear what you think about these changes, we are looking forward to your feedback on the Steam forums or Discord!

Have fun,

Kikimora Crew

notes.title: Major Update Alert: playtest-v0.1.0-beta2
notes.content:
Hello playtesters!

We just pushed out a massive update with a change that [b]will wipe your save files![/b]

[h1]Reworked Progression![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050579/fd39079ab31acd686a613a14a5b7806033e08390.png[/img]

The upgrades button is finally unlocked and you can unlock upgrades that will make you better and stronger across runs!

Including a completely new upgrade, which lets you reroll the drops you get from pizza deliveries!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050579/1c91baaaefc94378cc921d667808d05fd6327bd2.png[/img]

To unlock the upgrades you will need to get the TIPS you earn from pizza deliveries.

In addition, you might notice that enemies no longer drop anything except small nitro canisters. This is because drops now need to be unlocked by playing the game, so if you want to cheese a boss using the wingblades, you better plan ahead, and make sure to pickup a powerup that is placed on the map instead of relying on a lucky drop! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050579/12ff4735cb7a7c5c2202a64298bf56a0ffef1870.png[/img]
[i]This is what the unlock screen might look like, where you can choose what unlock you want.[/i]

In a similar fashion you will notice that vehicles, weapons and even items need to be unlocked by playing the game and leveling up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050579/d08505454647aeeeaf237ee25822f69ee5cb3c32.png[/img]
[i]If you want to unlock the Norrlander, you will need to clear the second level! No more skipping the sludge for you! Master the sludge, become the sludge, embrace the sludge![/i]

And finally, we added the [b]Pesto-pedia[/b], a handy list of everything you have unlocked, and where we will over time add some proper lore to enrich the Pest Apocalypse with narrative!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050579/e57e1389446228de2a5b9e73b50203ca49970fb2.png[/img]
[i]Please don't consider anything written here as cannon, it's mostly tech-guy nonsense![/i]

We will be pushing out more updates to these features as we prepare for Next Fest, so check back often in the next few days!

Give it a spin and tell us what you think!

Thank you for supporting our indie dream ❤

We can't wait to hear what you think about these changes, we are looking forward to your feedback on the Steam forums or Discord!

Have fun,

Kikimora Crew

notes.title: playtest-v0.0.3
notes.content:
Hi drivers,

this is not even an update! We have just introduced a more sane versioning system so it's easier for both you and us to keep track of what build you currently have!

Versions with bigger changes will from now on come with a corresponding change in the vX.X.X number.

However smaller changes might come in after those bigger versions and you will see them as something like
playtest-v0.0.3-4-gdb2ba2

The way to know if you're on a relevant newer version is to simply check if the vX.X.X corresponds to the latest update note. Everything else just means some other tiny changes or bugfixes came in afterwards.


Hopefully this all makes sense. If it doesn't, just hit us up on Discord!

Thank you for supporting our indie dream ❤

If you want to give us feedback, chat or anything else, hit us up on the Steam forums or Discord!

Have fun,

Kikimora Crew

notes.title: Powerups!
notes.content:
Hello drivers!

While we are collecting your feedback and bug reports we have been focusing on a new feature:
[h1]Powerups![/h1]

You might notice some enemies have blue bubbles with items floating above them:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050579/4d2f9d6002f18255819480d097006d8957c9f581.png[/img]

If you do, simply eliminate the pests, grab the item and enjoy the powerup! And experiment a bit, who knows, they might do more than just help you kill stuff.

You might also notice some powerups just laying around like trash:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050579/9726a488681314674f5284a50414394991180e8f.png[/img]
This is an unfortunate consequence of life in the Pest Apocalypse, and finders-keepers applies, so take those powerups as well!

In addition to powerups we have also tweaked some weapons, and updated the vehicle behavior a bit to hopefully improve your overall experience.

The version of the update is [i]playtest_362ce26[/i] and you can check that you have the correct update by looking in the bottom right corner on the main menu screen.

Thank you for supporting our indie dream ❤

If you want to give us feedback, chat or anything else, hit us up on the Steam forums or Discord!

Have fun,

Kikimora Crew
